name: Community water systems delivery tier
description: Tier (1-4) of water supply reliability determined by impact thresholds
calc_note: Tier classification based on delivery reliability thresholds

name: Community water systems surface water delivery volume
description: Volumetric surface water deliveries to community (urban/municipal) demand units
calc_note: Monthly aggregation of surface water deliveries to municipal contractors

name: Community water systems surface water delivery reliability
description: Water delivery shortage (%), expressed relative to exceedance value (95%)
calc_note: Probability that community experiences less than X% shortage in 95/100 years

name: Agricultural productivity tier
description: Tier (1-4) of agricultural productivity (revenue) determined by impact thresholds
calc_note: Tier classification based on revenue and productivity thresholds

name: Agricultural surface water delivery volume
description: Volumetric surface water deliveries to agricultural demand units
calc_note: Monthly aggregation of surface water deliveries to agricultural contractors

name: Agricultural Gross Revenues
description: Gross revenues in agricultural production per demand unit
calc_note: Annual economic analysis of crop production value

name: River environmental flow tier
description: Tier (1-4) flow condition determined by functional flow thresholds
calc_note: Tier classification based on functional flow criteria

name: River flows (% unimpaired)
description: Percent of unimpaired natural flow
calc_note: Monthly flow as percentage of unimpaired baseline

name: Environmental water deliveries to wildlife refuges
description: Volumetric surface water deliveries to refuge demand units
calc_note: Monthly deliveries to Level 2 and Level 4 refuge water supplies

name: Delta outflow volumes
description: Monthly and annual outflow volumes from the Delta to San Francisco Bay
calc_note: Net Delta outflow calculated from Sacramento and San Joaquin inflows minus exports and consumptive use

name: Delta outflow volumes (% of unimpaired)
description: Delta outflow expressed as percentage of unimpaired conditions
calc_note: Comparison of modeled outflow to historical unimpaired Delta outflow

name: April X2
description: X2 salinity position in April (distance from Golden Gate in km)
calc_note: Monthly average of daily X2 calculations during April

name: September X2
description: X2 salinity position in September (distance from Golden Gate in km)
calc_note: Monthly average of daily X2 calculations during September

name: Salinity constraints on in-Delta uses tier
description: Tier 1-4 corresponding to suitable salinity conditions for in-delta uses
calc_note: Tier classification based on salinity thresholds for beneficial uses

name: Delta export volumes
description: Water exported from the Delta via state and federal pumping facilities
calc_note: Combined exports from Harvey O. Banks and C.W. Jones pumping plants

name: Reservoir storage tier
description: Tier (1-4) of overall reservoir storage determined by historical reference thresholds
calc_note: Tier classification based on aggregate storage across major reservoirs

name: April reservoir storage volume
description: Storage volumes of major reservoirs (north and south of Delta) in April
calc_note: End-of-month storage aggregated across Shasta, Oroville, Folsom, and other major facilities

name: September reservoir storage volume
description: Storage volumes of major reservoirs (north and south of Delta) in September
calc_note: End-of-month storage aggregated across major facilities at end of irrigation season

name: Groundwater storage tier
description: Tier (1-4) of overall groundwater storage determined by historical reference thresholds
calc_note: Tier classification based on storage relative to sustainable yield and historical levels

name: Groundwater level change
description: Annual change in groundwater levels relative to baseline
calc_note: Water table elevation change measured at representative wells

name: Groundwater storage volume change
description: Annual change in groundwater storage volumes
calc_note: Volumetric storage change estimated from water table and specific yield

name: Salmon tier
description: Tier (1-4) of population status of winter run chinook salmon
calc_note: Tier classification based on spawner abundance and population trends

name: Maximum percent change of 10-year rolling average spawner abundance
description: Maximum percent change in spawner abundance compared to initial population size
calc_note: Analysis of 1000 simulation runs to generate exceedance curves
